items.title: Keep sessions to one task each
items.detail: Each reply read 183k tokens on average in the last 7 days (171k the week before). Re-reading that context was 42% of Claude spend. Start a new session for each task, and /clear when you switch to something unrelated, so replies stop carrying old work.

items.title: Start fresh after a break instead of resuming
items.detail: 20 cache rebuilds cost $21 in the last 7 days (18 the week before). Once a session sits idle for an hour its cache expires, and the next reply pays to write the whole conversation again. After a long break, start a new session with a short summary, or run /compact before you step away.

items.title: Ask for tests on the tricky part up front
items.detail: 62 later commits changed files from 25 tasks shipped in the last 28 days, most after PR #166 (8). Follow-up fixes usually mean the first pass missed a case, so ask Claude to write a test for the risky part before it builds.

items.title: Claude spend down 28% on the week before
items.detail: $97 in the last 7 days, against $136. Busiest day: Tue 24 Nov, at $46.

items.title: Biggest task this week: PR #249
items.detail: "feat(search): search your photos by words, on-device (#186)" cost $8.96 over 126 replies, about 2 times your median task ($3.91).
